summary: TASK-020: End-to-End Testing and Validation completed. Marketing Hub is 65% complete with critical gaps identified. Root cause: SCOPE_MISMATCH - repository contains Auto Claude with partial Marketing Hub features, not a separate marketing website. Key findings: (1) Core infrastructure exists (global_settings.py, API Settings UI, marketing agents), (2) Platform integrations completely missing (TASK-015 to TASK-018), (3) Campaign Planner agent implementation missing (prompt only), (4) No integration tests, (5) Documentation updated to reflect actual project scope. Critical blockers prevent production release.
